issue: An accepted render completed without an uploaded video URL

observed.nativeGetOutput: Completed metadata and thumbnail were present; video URL was absent.

sourceEvidence.fact: The upload helper catches upload errors and returns uploaded:false instead of failing the render worker.
The completed video URL is set only when the main upload returns a URL, or when uploads are disabled.
The worker response still marks ok:true even if the video URL was never set.
For upload-enabled jobs, the output directory is removed after the upload attempt.
Completion persists status completed and stores a null output_url when the worker URL is missing.

inference: An unavailable or failed main-video upload is consistent with the observed completed status, present thumbnail, and absent video URL. This inference does not identify the exact live storage error.
workflowResponse: Keep the completed-HTTPS guard; report the accepted job ID and direct the user to inspect the job before another paid submission.
